stories.title: Wildfire at New Brunswick military base contained, army officials say
stories.summary: The fire at Canada's second-largest military base began Oct. 28, and officials said it was caused by artillery shooting.

stories.title: First Nation criticizes Holt government for not consulting about lifting fracking ban
stories.summary: Premier Susan Holt's Liberal government is reviewing a long-standing ban on fracking and development of shale gas in the Maritime province.

stories.title: New Brunswick watches for trade relief after U.S. Democrats’ midterm victory
stories.summary: Political watchers and economic experts in New Brunswick are keeping a close eye on the impact of the Democrats' decisive victory in the United States midterms.

stories.title: Police watchdog investigating death of armed man found in burned Fredericton home
stories.summary: The police watchdog says crisis negotiators tried to communicate with the man for a couple of hours before the home started burning.

stories.title: Canada’s focus ‘hasn’t changed’ despite U.S. midterm blue wave, minister says
stories.summary: Canadian leaders say it would be “dangerous” to assume relations with the U.S. will change immediately following a major sweep of the House and the Senate by the Democrats Tuesday.

stories.title: Judge orders Bitcoin, laptop be returned to convicted killer William Sandeson
stories.summary: A judge has ordered a laptop containing William Sandeson’s Bitcoin returned to his family, with its disputed value ranging from $8,000 to over $200,000.

stories.title: How a New Brunswick island is caught in the middle of the Canada-U.S. trade war
stories.summary: A Canadian island reliant on the U.S. for everyday necessities is caught in the middle as tensions strain a centuries-old relationship.

stories.title: New Brunswick aims to become bigger player in Canada’s defence industry: premier
stories.summary: New Brunswick's provincial government has laid out a new strategy on how it aims to become a bigger player in Canada's defence sector.

stories.title: North Atlantic right whale spotted entangled in gear
stories.summary: Fisheries and Oceans Canada says a surveillance flight spotted the whale on Oct. 21 between New Brunswick's Acadian Peninsula, P.E.I. and Quebec's Îles-de-la-Madeleine.

stories.title: N.B. police issue public safety alert over suspected drug overdose spike in capital
stories.summary: The Fredericton Police Force says it responded to about 17 calls related to suspected overdoses between Wednesday and Friday morning.
